_notes: Minimal config for structural_priors_improved. The legacy ~600-line config with dead 'policy_prior', 'normalization', 'walk_forward', 'risk_off' blocks is gone. Everything here is wired to live code; nothing is documentation-only.

custom_features._step1_note: Step 1 of the roadmap reduces this to 6-8 RANK-NORMALIZED per-asset features. Step 0 keeps the legacy set to prove the new skeleton reproduces the calibrated apparatus.

env._cost_bps_notes: All-in TC in basis points per unit of L1 turnover. 10 bps default ~ 5 bps each side. Set to 0 to disable.
env._cadence_notes: 'daily' = legacy. 'weekly' = native env action-repeat: agent's action only takes effect on weekly_day; on other bars the env replays the last rebalance-day action and accumulates reward.

early_stopping._notes: selection_metric is implicit (IR-only; the sharpe selector caused EW-anchored checkpoint pathology in the triage). Raise val_fraction to 0.3 if testing the IR-selection-overfit-on-small-val hypothesis.
